app.title: Security DNS
dash.quick.hint: Pick one mode. It starts that tool and stops the other tools.
mode.spoofdpi.desc: Keeps your public IP. Splits the TLS handshake on this computer so DPI equipment cannot read website names.
mode.warp.desc: Hides destination IPs from your ISP through an encrypted tunnel to Cloudflare. Changes your public IP and may change your apparent country.
mode.wireguard.desc: The same Cloudflare WARP tunnel through the standard WireGuard client. Same trade-offs as WARP.
dash.kill: KILL SWITCH: turn off all tools
dash.kill.desc: Stops every proxy and tunnel at once and keeps encrypted DNS on. Nothing is uninstalled. It is an emergency off switch; it does not block traffic if a tunnel drops.
dash.restore.desc: Puts your DNS, proxy, and network settings back exactly as they were before this app changed them. The app and tools stay installed.
dash.install_missing.desc: Downloads and installs every tool that is not installed yet. Nothing is started.
dash.update.desc: Checks for newer SpoofDPI and wgcf releases and installs them. A running tool restarts on the new version.
tool.spoofdpi.name: SpoofDPI
tool.spoofdpi.desc: A local proxy that splits your TLS handshake so DPI equipment cannot read website names. Keeps your public IP.
tool.warp.name: Cloudflare WARP
tool.warp.desc: An encrypted tunnel to Cloudflare that hides destination IPs from your ISP. Changes your public IP and may change your apparent country.
tool.wireguard.name: WireGuard (wgcf)
tool.wireguard.desc: The same Cloudflare WARP tunnel run by the standard WireGuard client with a profile made by wgcf. Same trade-offs as WARP.
action.install.tip: Download and install the tool. Nothing starts yet.
action.start.tip: Run it now. It stops again when you stop it or restart, unless enabled.
action.stop.tip: Stop it now. Nothing is deleted.
action.enable.tip: Start it automatically at boot or sign-in.
action.uninstall.tip: Stop it and delete what this app installed for it. Your original settings stay backed up.
confirm.tunnel: This tool hides destination IPs from your ISP, but your public IP changes, your apparent country may change (traffic exits at the nearest Cloudflare data center), and traffic volume stays visible to your ISP. Continue?
confirm.restore: Restore your original network, DNS, and proxy settings and stop all tools? The app and tools stay installed.
confirm.uninstall: Stop this tool and delete what this app installed for it?
dialog.title: A problem was found
problem.port_in_use.title: Port is already taken
problem.port_in_use.explain: Another application is using the port SpoofDPI needs.
problem.port_in_use.fix: I will choose a free port automatically and save it in Advanced Settings.
problem.unsupported_flag.title: SpoofDPI does not accept these options
problem.unsupported_flag.explain: The installed SpoofDPI version rejected the startup options.
problem.unsupported_flag.fix: I will switch to a different option style (config file, flags, port only, or none) and retry.
problem.missing_resolvconf.title: resolvconf is missing
problem.missing_resolvconf.explain: WireGuard needs the resolvconf tool to set DNS, and it is not installed.
problem.missing_resolvconf.fix: I will install resolvconf (openresolv on Arch, Fedora, and openSUSE) with your package manager.
problem.missing_resolvconf.alt: Let this app handle DNS instead (recommended)
problem.missing_tool.title: A required program is missing
problem.missing_tool.explain: A program this operation needs is not installed: {tool}
problem.missing_tool.fix: I will install it with your package manager and retry.
problem.permission.title: Permission denied
problem.permission.explain: The system refused the operation because of missing permissions.
problem.permission.fix: I will relaunch the app with administrator rights. Run it again from there.
problem.network.title: Network problem
problem.network.explain: A connection timed out or the server could not be reached.
problem.network.fix: I will wait a moment, raise the network timeout, and retry.
problem.ratelimit.title: Download limit reached
problem.ratelimit.explain: GitHub is limiting requests from your network.
problem.ratelimit.fix: I will wait 30 seconds and retry. A GitHub token in Advanced Settings avoids this.
problem.resolved_missing.title: systemd-resolved is missing
problem.resolved_missing.explain: Encrypted DNS needs systemd-resolved, which is not available.
problem.resolved_missing.fix: I will install and enable systemd-resolved, then retry.
problem.no_asset.title: No download found for this system
problem.no_asset.explain: The project does not publish a build for this operating system or CPU.
problem.no_asset.fix: I will open Advanced Settings so you can point to a program you built yourself.
problem.checksum.title: Download failed its integrity check
problem.checksum.explain: The downloaded file does not match its published SHA-256 checksum, so it may be corrupted or tampered with.
problem.checksum.fix: I will discard it and download a fresh copy.
problem.conflict.title: Two tunnels cannot run together
problem.conflict.explain: Cloudflare WARP and WireGuard both route all traffic, so they conflict.
problem.conflict.fix: I will stop {other} and then start this tool.
problem.doh_unsupported.title: This Windows version cannot use system DNS-over-HTTPS
problem.doh_unsupported.explain: System-wide DNS-over-HTTPS needs Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or newer.
problem.doh_unsupported.fix: I will continue without changing system DNS, so no plaintext queries are sent. Enable Secure DNS in your browser instead.
problem.unknown.title: Unexpected error
problem.unknown.explain: The operation failed for a reason I do not recognize.
problem.unknown.fix: I will retry the operation. The technical details show the cause.
settings.spoofPort.label: SpoofDPI port
settings.spoofPort.help: Port on this computer where SpoofDPI listens (default 8080). If it is busy, a free port is chosen for you.
settings.spoofArgStyle.label: SpoofDPI argument style
settings.spoofArgStyle.help: How start options are passed. Auto reads the installed build help; config, flags, port, or none force one style.
settings.spoofExtraArgs.label: SpoofDPI extra arguments
settings.spoofExtraArgs.help: Added to the SpoofDPI command line. For advanced users.
settings.dnsServers.label: DNS servers
settings.dnsServers.help: Encrypted DNS servers used for every lookup, separated by spaces. On Linux you can write ip#hostname to pin a TLS name.
settings.dohTemplate.label: DNS-over-HTTPS template (Windows)
settings.dohTemplate.help: The DoH address your DNS servers use on Windows. It must match your DNS servers.
settings.wgEndpoint.label: WireGuard endpoint
settings.wgEndpoint.help: Replaces the server address (host:port) in the WireGuard profile. Leave empty to keep the Cloudflare default.
settings.wgStripDns.label: WireGuard DNS handling (Linux)
settings.wgStripDns.toggle: Let this app handle DNS instead of the WireGuard profile
settings.wgStripDns.help: Turn on to avoid needing resolvconf. Turn off if you want the profile to set DNS itself.
settings.manageSystemProxy.label: System proxy
settings.manageSystemProxy.toggle: Point the system proxy at SpoofDPI while it runs
settings.manageSystemProxy.help: Most apps then use SpoofDPI automatically. It is turned off again when SpoofDPI stops.
settings.spoofPath.label: SpoofDPI program path
settings.spoofPath.help: Use your own SpoofDPI program instead of the downloaded one. Leave empty for the managed copy.
settings.wgcfPath.label: wgcf program path
settings.wgcfPath.help: Use your own wgcf program. Leave empty for the managed copy.
settings.wgQuickPath.label: wg-quick program path (Linux)
settings.wgQuickPath.help: Use a specific wg-quick program. Leave empty to find it automatically.
settings.warpCliPath.label: warp-cli program path
settings.warpCliPath.help: Use a specific warp-cli program. Leave empty to find it automatically.
settings.networkTimeoutSec.label: Network timeout
settings.networkTimeoutSec.help: Seconds to wait for a connection before giving up (5 to 300).
settings.githubToken.label: GitHub token
settings.githubToken.help: Optional. Avoids GitHub download rate limits. Stored only on this computer.
settings.invalid_value: The value for "{name}" is not valid.
about.security_text: Do NOT open public issues for security vulnerabilities. Report them privately by email to {email}, or through GitHub's Private Vulnerability Reporting (repository Security tab, Report a vulnerability). This protects the community until a fix is released.
about.single_version: Use either this GUI or the CLI scripts on one computer, not both at the same time, because both manage the same DNS and proxy settings.
log.failed: The operation did not complete. See the Log tab.
log.giving_up: The same problem keeps happening, so the operation was stopped.
log.waiting_30: GitHub is limiting requests. Waiting 30 seconds...
log.backup_done: Your original network settings were backed up.
log.dns_skipped: System DNS was skipped. Enable Secure DNS in your browser.
log.no_backup: No backup was found, so there is nothing to restore.
log.warp_self_update: The Cloudflare WARP client updates itself.
log.wait_before_close: A task is still running. Wait for it to finish before closing.
elevation.title: Administrator rights needed
elevation.text: Security DNS changes DNS, proxy, and network settings, so it needs administrator rights. Relaunch now with administrator rights?
